name: DeathShake
description: Adds a customizable camera shake effect whenever you crash.

enabled.name: Shake
enabled.description: Enable or disable the camera shake effect when crashing.

speed.name: Speed of Shake
speed.description: Controls how fast the camera shake plays.

intensity.name: Shake Intensity
intensity.description: Distance in pixels the camera moves on crash.

rotation.name: Camera Rotation
rotation.description: Adds a slight camera tilt during the shake.

practice.name: Practice Mode
practice.description: Trigger camera shake in Practice Mode.
